matrixVersionSeed.label: Initial scope matrix import — DB Scoops Full Matrix
matrixVersionSeed.sourceName: Decision Matrix For Selecting the Right Project Management Framework For the Scop.xlsx

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK 7th Ed – Governance Performance Domain
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Organization Theme / Directing a Project
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Phase-gate governance
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean Portfolio Management; Scrum – Scrum of Scrums
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Governance tailored per project layer
profile.caseScenario: A multinational launching a digital transformation program needs a governance framework that balances enterprise oversight with team-level agility. Governance must cover portfolio-level decisions, investment tracking, compliance gates, and decentralized execution.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Scope Management KA (Collect Requirements, Define Scope, WBS)
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Value Stream Mapping (define value scope)
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – User Stories, Story Mapping, Product Backlog
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Scope Baseline, WBS, Change Control Board
profile.agileFrameworksValue: Scrum – Product Backlog / Sprint Backlog; SAFe – Program Backlog
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Scope frozen at milestone level, flexible within sprints
profile.caseScenario: An ERP implementation project with over 200 requirements spanning 5 business units. Scope must be locked per phase but flexible within delivery teams. Traditional WBS required for compliance, agile backlog for execution.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Schedule Management KA (Define Activities, Sequence, Develop Schedule)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Gantt charts, Critical Path Method, PERT
profile.agileFrameworksValue: Scrum – Sprint Planning / Burndown; SAFe – PI Planning, ART Sync
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Master schedule + sprint iterations within phases
profile.caseScenario: A government infrastructure project with a 24-month timeline, regulatory milestones, and 8 parallel streams. Critical Path Method needed for overall timeline, but delivery teams use sprint-based scheduling for design and testing phases.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Cost Management KA (Estimate Costs, Determine Budget, Control Costs)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Business Case Theme / Cost Tolerance
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – PP (Project Planning) – Budget & Cost Estimation
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Cost of Delay, Economic prioritization
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Story Points, Burn Rate, Rolling Wave Estimation
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Earned Value Management, Fixed Budget Baseline
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean Budgets, Guardrails; Scrum – Sprint cost tracking
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Fixed budget per phase, flexible allocation within sprints
profile.caseScenario: A pharmaceutical R&D project with a total budget of €5M, strict compliance-driven cost tracking, and quarterly review gates. R&D teams operate in discovery mode (agile budgeting), while production milestones follow EVM-based cost control.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Quality Management KA (Plan, Manage, Control Quality)
profile.aspiceValue: SUP.1 – Quality Assurance; SWE.6 – SW Testing
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Definition of Done, Test-Driven Development
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – QA gates, Inspection, Testing phases
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Built-in Quality, Continuous Integration; XP – TDD, Pair Programming
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – QA gates at milestones, continuous testing in sprints
profile.caseScenario: An automotive embedded systems project where safety-critical software must comply with ISO 26262. Quality assurance is non-negotiable at gate reviews (V-model), while development teams use TDD and CI/CD for daily builds and automated testing.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Resource Management KA (Plan, Acquire, Develop, Manage)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – RACI matrix, Resource leveling, Org charts
profile.agileFrameworksValue: Scrum – Scrum Team; SAFe – Agile Release Train, PI Planning
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Central resource pool + team-level self-organization
profile.caseScenario: A consulting firm staffing 12 concurrent projects across 3 regions. Resource allocation requires portfolio-level visibility (traditional RACI), while individual project teams self-organize within their Scrum teams. Cross-training is key.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Communication Management KA (Plan, Manage, Monitor)
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Status Reports, Steering Committee Meetings
profile.agileFrameworksValue: Scrum – Events (Daily, Review, Retro); SAFe – Inspect & Adapt
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Formal reporting at milestones, daily standups within teams
profile.caseScenario: A healthcare IT project with multiple stakeholders including clinicians, regulators, and IT teams. Executive reporting must follow formal templates (monthly), while development teams rely on daily standups and sprint reviews.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Risk Management KA (Identify, Analyze, Plan Response, Monitor)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Risk register, Probability-Impact Matrix
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated); Scrum – Sprint Retro risk review
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Enterprise risk register + team-level risk boards
profile.caseScenario: A fintech startup building a payment platform under strict regulatory constraints (PCI-DSS). Enterprise-level risks tracked in a formal register (compliance, data breach), while feature teams use risk-adjusted backlog prioritization and spike stories for technical risks.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Procurement Management KA (Plan, Conduct, Control)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Fixed-price contracts, RFP/RFQ process
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Supplier collaboration in ART; Scrum – Vendor Sprint integration
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Fixed contracts for hardware, agile contracts for software
profile.caseScenario: A defense project procuring both hardware (fixed-price contract) and software (agile T&M contract). Procurement must manage vendor milestones using traditional RFP-based tracking for hardware, while software vendors are integrated into sprint ceremonies.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Stakeholder Management KA (Identify, Plan, Manage, Monitor)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Organization Theme / Stakeholder Engagement Strategy
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Product Owner as stakeholder proxy, Sprint Review demos
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Power/Interest Grid, Stakeholder Register
profile.agileFrameworksValue: Scrum – Product Owner; SAFe – Business Owners, Customers in PI Planning
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Formal stakeholder register + ongoing agile engagement
profile.caseScenario: A smart city initiative involving 15+ stakeholder groups (government agencies, citizens, tech vendors, utility companies). Formal stakeholder analysis and engagement plans for executive sponsors, while citizen feedback is collected via agile product increments and public sprint reviews.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Integration Management KA (Develop Charter, Direct Work, Manage Knowledge)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Starting Up / Initiating / Directing / Closing a Project
profile.isoValue: ISO 21500 – Integration (Direct Project Work, Control Changes)
profile.ipmaValue: ICB4 – Practice: Project Design (3.01), Plan & Control (3.02)
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Systems Thinking, End-to-end value stream
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Integrated Change Control, Project Charter
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Solution Train, ART; Scrum – Scrum of Scrums
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Integrated change control + agile CI/CD
profile.caseScenario: A bank merging two core banking platforms. Integration management must coordinate 20+ workstreams, 3 vendors, and regulatory approvals. A formal project charter and integrated change control board govern the program, while individual streams use Scrum and CI/CD.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Integration KA (Perform Integrated Change Control)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Change Control Board, Formal CR process
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Continuous Exploration; Scrum – Backlog Refinement as change vehicle
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – CCB for scope changes, agile backlog for feature changes
profile.caseScenario: An airline migrating from legacy reservation systems to a modern cloud platform. Major scope changes require CCB approval and regulatory filing, while feature changes within sprints are managed through backlog refinement and PO prioritization.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Benefits Management Plan / Stewardship Domain
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Business Case Theme / Benefits Review Plan
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – OPF (Organizational Process Focus) – Benefits tracking
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Value Stream, Customer Value focus
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Working Software = Primary measure of progress
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Benefits tracking at project close
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean Portfolio Management, OKRs; Scrum – Product Goal
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Benefits baseline at initiation, incremental tracking in sprints
profile.caseScenario: A government digitization program expected to save €50M over 5 years. Benefits must be tracked quarterly against a baseline (formal KPI framework), while individual delivery teams measure incremental value delivered per sprint using OKRs.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK 7th Ed – Adaptive Delivery Principles
profile.isoValue: ISO 21500 – Adaptable (no specific agile scale guidance)
profile.ipmaValue: ICB4 – Practice: Agile (referenced in delivery approach)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Not directly applicable at scale
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe (Full); LeSS; Nexus; Disciplined Agile (DA)
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – SAFe/LeSS + governance overlay for enterprise compliance
profile.caseScenario: A telco operating 50+ scrum teams across 6 product lines. Requires scaled agile framework to coordinate PI Planning, dependency management, and portfolio-level alignment, while maintaining team autonomy and fast delivery cadence.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Portfolio Management (organizational alignment)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Business Case across portfolio (MoP alignment)
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – OPF (Organizational Process Focus) at portfolio level
profile.aspiceValue: Not directly addressed at portfolio level
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Decentralized decision-making at portfolio level
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Portfolio gating, Stage-gate for investment
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean Portfolio Management (Strategy, Funding, Governance)
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Portfolio governance + lean funding per value stream
profile.caseScenario: A large insurance company with €200M annual IT budget managing 80+ initiatives. Portfolio decisions must align with strategic themes, use lean budgets at the value stream level, and apply guardrails instead of traditional project-by-project funding.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK 7th Ed – Delivery Performance Domain (Continuous Delivery)
profile.aspiceValue: SWE.5 – SW Integration; SWE.6 – SW Testing
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Continuous Flow, Single Piece Flow
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Release management gates
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – DevOps (CALMR); XP – Continuous Integration
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – CI/CD for software, gated releases for regulated components
profile.caseScenario: A SaaS company deploying to production 50 times per day. Full CI/CD pipeline with automated testing, canary releases, and feature flags. Regulated features (PCI) follow a gated release process with manual approval steps.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Integration Management (systems context)
profile.ipmaValue: ICB4 – Practice: Project Design (3.01) – systems perspective
profile.aspiceValue: SYS.1–SYS.5 – Full Systems Engineering Process Group
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Not directly applicable to full SE lifecycle
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – V-Model, SE lifecycle (Requirements → Design → Integration → V&V)
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – System Demo, Solution Intent; ASPICE – Agile SE extension
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – V-Model for system architecture, agile for subsystem development
profile.caseScenario: An autonomous vehicle project integrating hardware (sensors, ECUs), software (perception, planning), and safety systems. Systems engineering follows the V-model for architecture and integration, while software subsystems use agile sprints with continuous integration.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Quality and Risk (safety context)
profile.aspiceValue: Full ASPICE alignment for automotive safety
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Built-in Quality (safety as quality dimension)
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Limited applicability for safety-critical (requires adaptation)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – V-Model (mandatory for safety-critical domains)
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe + Safety (Agile Safety Management); ASPICE Agile extension
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – V-Model for safety lifecycle, agile for non-safety components
profile.caseScenario: A medical device manufacturer developing an insulin pump. Safety lifecycle follows IEC 62304 (V-model), traceability from requirements to tests is mandatory, and formal safety reviews are required at each gate. Non-safety software (companion app) uses agile.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Manage Project Knowledge (Integration KA)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Lessons Learned Log / End Project Report
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – A3 Reports, Knowledge sharing culture
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Lessons learned database, Post-mortem reviews
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Communities of Practice, Innovation and Planning Iteration
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Formal lessons learned + continuous retrospectives
profile.caseScenario: A global engineering firm with 10,000+ employees wants to capture and reuse project knowledge. A formal knowledge base (SharePoint/Confluence) stores deliverables and lessons learned, while communities of practice and retrospectives drive continuous learning.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Manage Project Knowledge (configuration items)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Configuration Management Strategy / Product Status Account
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Configuration Identification, Control, Status Accounting, Audit
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Continuous Integration, Trunk-based development
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Formal CI/CM for deliverables, Git-flow for code
profile.caseScenario: An aerospace project with 500+ configuration items (hardware specs, software versions, test reports). Formal configuration management (identification, control, status accounting, audit) required for certification, while software teams use Git-flow and CI/CD.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Monitor & Control (Measurement Performance Domain)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Progress Theme / Tolerance & Exception Reporting
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Key Lean Metrics (Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – EVM (CPI, SPI), Milestone tracking
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Flow Metrics, PI Predictability; Kanban – CFD, Lead Time
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – EVM at program level, flow metrics at team level
profile.caseScenario: A digital agency managing 30 client projects simultaneously. Program-level tracking uses EVM (CPI, SPI), while individual teams measure velocity, cycle time, and cumulative flow. A unified dashboard aggregates both perspectives for executives.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Stakeholder & Team Performance Domain (change context)
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – OPF (Organizational Process Focus) – Change readiness
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Kaizen culture, Respect for People
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Kotter's 8 Steps, ADKAR, Prosci
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean-Agile Leadership, Organizational Agility
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Structured OCM framework + agile coaching
profile.caseScenario: A manufacturing company transitioning from waterfall to agile delivery. Organizational change management follows ADKAR/Kotter for leadership alignment, while agile coaches embed within teams to drive mindset shift and practice adoption.

profile.pmiValue: Standard for Program Management (4th Ed) – Benefits, Governance, Lifecycle
profile.aspiceValue: Not directly addressed at programme level
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Value Stream alignment across programs
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Gantt-based program scheduling, Dependency tracking
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Agile Release Train (ART); LeSS – Area Product Owner
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Traditional program governance + agile delivery trains
profile.caseScenario: A retail bank launching a digital banking program comprising 8 projects (mobile app, API gateway, core banking, compliance, data analytics, UX redesign, legacy migration, security). Program governance follows MSP, while individual projects use Scrum/SAFe.

profile.pmiValue: Standard for Portfolio Management (4th Ed) – Strategic Alignment
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – OPM (Organizational Performance Management) at portfolio
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Portfolio scoring, Stage-gate investment
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Lean Portfolio Management; DA – Portfolio Management
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Strategic portfolio planning + agile value stream funding
profile.caseScenario: A conglomerate managing 200+ initiatives across 5 business units. Portfolio management aligns investments with strategic themes, balances capacity vs. demand, and uses lean budgets to fund value streams rather than individual projects.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Cost/Schedule Performance (EVM: CPI, SPI, EAC, ETC)
profile.ipmaValue: ICB4 – Practice: Control & Reports (3.02) – EVM context
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – PMC (Project Monitoring and Control) – EVM sub-practice
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – AgileEVM, Story Point-based earned value
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Full EVM (BCWS, BCWP, ACWP, CPI, SPI, EAC, TCPI)
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – PI Predictability Measure; AgileEVM adaptations
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – EVM at program level, velocity-based tracking at team level
profile.caseScenario: A defense contractor building a satellite system under EVMS (Earned Value Management System) contractual requirements. Full EVM compliance at program level, while software subsystem teams track velocity and story points, aggregated into EVM metrics for reporting.

profile.pmiValue: PMI-ACP – Agile Practitioner (coaching, facilitation, mentoring)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 Agile – Tailoring for agile environments
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – PMO coaching, Methodology training
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – SPC (SAFe Program Consultant), RTE; Scrum – Scrum Master; ICAgile
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Agile coaching for teams + traditional PM mentoring for governance
profile.caseScenario: A large enterprise starting an agile transformation with 200+ people in 25 teams. Requires agile coaches at team, program, and enterprise levels. Coaches must facilitate PI Planning, train Scrum Masters, and mentor leadership on Lean-Agile mindset.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Quality & Governance (compliance alignment)
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – Limited guidance for regulatory compliance
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Formal audit trails, Phase-gate approvals, Document-centric
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Compliance as built-in quality; Agile in regulated (GxP, SOX)
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Compliance gates at milestones, agile delivery within gates
profile.caseScenario: A pharmaceutical company developing a drug tracking system under FDA 21 CFR Part 11. Every requirement must be traceable to a validated test. Formal audit trails and document control are mandatory, while development teams use agile sprints with automated compliance checks.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK 7th Ed – Stewardship Domain (sustainability context)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Business Case (ESG as benefit driver)
profile.cmmiValue: CMMI – Not directly addressed (process improvement context)
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – ESG reporting as project deliverable
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Measure & Grow (sustainability metrics)
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – ESG governance overlay + agile delivery of sustainability features
profile.caseScenario: An energy company building a carbon footprint tracking platform. ESG compliance requirements (EU Taxonomy, GRI Standards) must be met through formal governance, while the platform itself is developed using agile with sustainability metrics as acceptance criteria.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Procurement Management KA (Vendor-focused)
profile.prince2Value: PRINCE2 – Commercial Management / Managing Product Delivery (vendor)
profile.aspiceValue: ACQ.3 – Contract Agreement; ACQ.4 – Supplier Monitoring
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Fixed-price/T&M contracts, SLA management
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Agile Contracts, Supplier integration in ART
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Fixed contracts for known scope, agile contracts for discovery
profile.caseScenario: A logistics company working with 5 software vendors (ERP, WMS, TMS, IoT, analytics). Each vendor has different contract types (fixed-price for ERP, T&M for IoT). Vendor performance tracked via SLAs, with agile integration for sprint-aligned delivery.

profile.pmiValue: PMI Guide to Business Analysis – Requirements elicitation, analysis, traceability
profile.aspiceValue: SYS.2 – System Requirements Analysis; SWE.1 – SW Requirements
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Value Stream Mapping (requirements as value flow)
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – User Stories, Epics, Story Mapping, BDD
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – BRD, FRD, Use Cases, Traceability Matrix
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Features/Capabilities, Enablers; Scrum – PBI refinement
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – BRD for compliance, User Stories for delivery teams
profile.caseScenario: A banking project requiring 500+ requirements across regulatory, functional, and technical domains. Business analysts produce formal BRDs for audit trail and regulatory compliance, then translate them into user stories and epics for delivery teams.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Quality Management (Testing as quality control)
profile.isoValue: ISO/IEC 29119 – Software Testing / ISO/IEC 25010 – Quality Model
profile.aspiceValue: SWE.4 – SW Unit Verification; SWE.5 – Integration; SWE.6 – Testing
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Built-in Quality, Stop the line
profile.agileFrameworkValue: Agile – TDD, ATDD, BDD, Continuous Testing
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – Test plans, Test cases, Defect tracking, UAT phases
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Test-first, Continuous Integration; XP – TDD, Pair Programming
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Formal test plans at milestones, automated testing in sprints
profile.caseScenario: A railway signaling system where safety-critical tests (SIL 4) require formal test plans and traceability to requirements. Unit and integration testing follows TDD in sprints, while system-level testing follows V-model verification with formal review boards.

profile.pmiValue: PMBOK – Integration Management (architectural decisions)
profile.aspiceValue: SWE.2 – SW Architectural Design; SYS.3 – System Architectural Design
profile.leanMethodValue: Lean – Set-Based Design, Last Responsible Moment
profile.traditionalMethodValue: Waterfall – TOGAF, Zachman, Big Design Up Front
profile.agileFrameworksValue: SAFe – Architectural Runway, Enablers; Scrum – Technical Backlog
profile.hybridMethodValue: Hybrid – Intentional architecture foundation + emergent design in sprints
profile.caseScenario: A cloud migration project redesigning a monolith into microservices. High-level architecture (TOGAF-based) defines the target state and migration roadmap, while individual microservice teams use emergent design patterns within sprints, contributing to the architectural runway.
